 Chris Sutton & Alan Shearer split on Bournemouth vs Leeds United predictions 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Chris Sutton and Alan Shearer have offered contrasting calls for Leeds United ’s Premier League trip to Bournemouth. With Leeds at the Vitality Stadium this afternoon, Sutton leans towards a draw while Shearer backs a home win.
 BBC Sport reports that Sutton expects Leeds to take a point from a Bournemouth side that may feel their midweek exertions, and he has predicted 1-1. Leeds have drawn five of their eight league games, including three of the past four, and, despite not being free-scoring, are solid at the back, second only to Arsenal.
 OneFootball Videos
 Bournemouth arrive in outstanding form, with five straight wins in all competitions without conceding, the latest a 3-0 Carabao Cup victory over Aston Villa on Wednesday. Sutton suggested the past week could still leave a mark on Marco Rose’s side.
 Bournemouth rotated on Wednesday, with Marcus Tavernier, Rayan and Justin Kluivert playing 45 minutes apiece, while striker Evanilson did not feature. That depth leads Shearer to think the midweek schedule will matter less.
 He says Bournemouth are now cooking and that Leeds are finding it hard to rack up wins, so he is going with the form team at home. His call is a Bournemouth win.
 Source: yorkshireeveningpost.co.uk
